meta.name: design-is
meta.description: Audit a design against Dieter Rams' ten "Good design is..." principles, then hand off a /make-plan prompt for one of three outcomes — new design, refine design, or redesign. Use when the user says "audit this design", "design review", "check this UI against Rams", "is this UI good", "critique this design", "design audit", or asks for a critique that should lead to a plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 对照迪特·拉姆斯十大原则审核设计并生成改进方案
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要依据经典设计原则来评估和优化界面设计。
copy.tagline_en: Audit designs against Dieter Rams' ten principles and generate improvement plans
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to evaluate and improve interface designs based on classic design principles.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会按 Dieter Rams 的十条「好设计」原则逐条审计你的设计：每条给 0–3 分并附证据，汇总总分后给出结论（新建 / 改进 / 重设计），并输出一份可直接运行的 /make-plan 提示词。
howto.when: 当你要求「审计这个设计」、「设计评审」或检查某个 UI 是否符合 Rams 原则，或想要一次能引出计划的批评时触发。

say.text: 审计这个设计，按 Rams 十原则逐条打分
say.note: 产物写入 DESIGN-IS-<日期>/ 目录

say.text: 这个 UI 够不够好？请逐条列证据
say.note: 每条评分须附 file:line 或实测值

say.text: 帮我判断该新建、改进还是重设计，并给出 /make-plan 提示词
say.note: 只输出一份可直接用的交接提示词

howto.what_en: Claude audits your design against Dieter Rams' ten "Good design is..." principles: scores each 0-3 with cited evidence, totals them, issues a verdict (NEW / REFINE / REDESIGN), and emits a ready-to-run /make-plan prompt.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to audit a design, run a design review, or check a UI against Rams' principles, or want a critique that leads to a plan.

say_en.text: Audit this design against Rams' ten principles
Is this UI good? List the evidence per principle
say_en.note: Each score needs a cited anchor

say_en.text: Should this be NEW, REFINE, or REDESIGN? Give the /make-plan prompt
